mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, main_id, approve_status, origin_seller_id, origin_seller_name, change_seller_id, change_seller_name, start_date, approve_user_id, approve_user_name, approve_time, remark
mapper.select: select cbs.approve_status as tabFlag, count(1) as count from customer_b2b_seller_change cbs inner join customer_info ci on cbs.main_id = ci.id where cbs.is_deleted = false and ci.is_deleted = false group by cbs.approve_status

select cbs.id, cbs.main_id as mainId, ci.code, ci,name, ci.short_name as shortName, cbs.origin_seller_name as originSellerName, cbs.change_seller_name as changeSellerName, cbs.approve_status as approveStatus, cbs.approve_user_name as approveUserName, cbs.create_user_name as createUserName, cbs.create_time as createTime, cbs.start_date as startDate, cbs.approve_time as approveTime from customer_b2b_seller_change cbs inner join customer_info ci on cbs.main_id = ci.id where ${params.sqlMap.default} and cbs.is_deleted = false and ci.is_deleted = false
